info.title: CORE OEM API
info.description:
The CORE API surface — the stable, versioned interface that external
integrations and downstream distributions consume to embed CORE's
constitutional governance layer.

**Stability policy:** see [ADR-087](https://github.com/DariuszNewecki/CORE/blob/main/.specs/decisions/ADR-087-oem-api-versioning-and-stability-policy.md).
**Route classification:** see [CORE-OEM-API paper](https://github.com/DariuszNewecki/CORE/blob/main/.specs/papers/CORE-OEM-API.md).

Routes marked `internal` (or absent from this spec) are CORE-operator
concerns — daemon lifecycle, autonomy-loop triggers, CI gate dispatch.
They are subject to change without notice and not part of this contract.

get.description: Return the capability registry from the knowledge graph. Sidecar consumers (F-34 web dashboard) use this to render the capability tree and to anchor proposal/action views against the constitutional capability taxonomy.

schema.title: Response List Capabilities V1 Knowledge Capabilities Get

post.description: Build a proposal from a goal + action sequence, compute its risk, and (when `write=true`) persist it via ProposalService. With `write=false` (default) the proposal is constructed and risk-scored in-memory but NOT written to the database — useful for dry-run validation. Returns the proposal's `to_dict()` shape either way.

schema.title: Response Create Proposal V1 Proposals Post

get.description: List proposals, optionally filtered by `status`. When `status` is omitted, returns proposals awaiting approval. `limit` is capped at 500. Pass `after=<next_cursor>` from a previous response to advance the page. F-34 (web dashboard) consumes this endpoint to render the proposal queue.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response.
schema.title: After

parameters.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response.

schema.title: Response List Proposals V1 Proposals Get

get.description: Return the complete governance chain for a proposal: the proposal itself, every linked finding (detected violations), and the execution consequence (files changed, git SHAs). `consequence` is null when the proposal has not yet been executed. Returns 404 if the proposal does not exist.
Return a proposal by `proposal_id`. Returns 404 if no proposal exists with that id.

post.description: Approve a proposal awaiting governance review. `approval_authority` is non-omittable per URS NFR.5 and validated against the `proposal_approval_authority` closed set inside ProposalStateManager. Returns 404 if the proposal doesn't exist; 400 if the authority is outside the closed vocabulary or the proposal is in a non-approvable state.

schema.title: Response Approve Proposal V1 Proposals  Proposal Id  Approve Post

post.description: Reject a proposal with a reason. Per ADR-010 §7a, rejection is symmetric with `mark_failed`: any findings parked at `deferred_to_proposal` are revived (flipped to `awaiting_reaudit` per ADR-045) so the audit sensor re-adjudicates them. Response includes `revived_count` for the operator. Returns 404 if the proposal doesn't exist.

schema.title: Response Reject Proposal V1 Proposals  Proposal Id  Reject Post

post.description: Execute an approved proposal as a governor-direct override. Defaults to dry-run; pass `{"write": true}` to apply changes. The proposal must be in approved status; ProposalExecutor manages its own session lifecycle.

schema.title: Response Execute Proposal V1 Proposals  Proposal Id  Execute Post

get.description: Reverse lookup: given a blackboard finding entry ID, locate the proposal it was deferred to and return the full governance chain — the proposal, all linked findings, and the execution consequence. Returns 404 if the entry does not exist or has not been linked to a proposal.

get.summary: List delegated findings (the assisted-lane work queue)
get.description: Return findings delegated for human-gated remediation — the Assisted Remediation Lane work queue. A delegated finding is one at `status=indeterminate` with `resolution_mechanism=human` (ADR-109). Ordered oldest-first; the `limit` query param caps the response size. The context-bundle exporter (#653) will enrich each entry later; for now the raw finding payload is returned.

get.summary: Pull the next delegated finding (FIFO head)
get.description: Return the oldest delegated finding — the lane's 'pull next work' surface — or 404 if the lane is empty. The rich context bundle (#653) will enrich this later; for now the raw finding is returned. Declared before /{finding_id} so 'next' is not captured as an id.

get.summary: Get a single delegated finding with its context bundle
get.description: Return one delegated finding by id (same governor-inbox predicate as the list) enriched with the #653 context bundle — rule rationale, whether the rule is still in the active registry, and the remediation-map guidance. 404 if it is not a live lane item — already worked, resolved, or never delegated.

post.summary: Mark a delegated finding as being worked
post.description: Stamp a delegated finding as in-progress by an external agent (ADR-109 §2). Claiming does not change the finding's status — it stays a live lane item — it only records who is working it so it is visibly tracked, not parked. 404 if it is not a live lane item.

post.summary: Ingest a validated agent diff as a human-gated proposal
post.description: Create a human-gated multi-file proposal from an agent-authored diff that has already cleared `assisted.validate_diff` (ADR-109 D3/D4). This endpoint is transport-only: LaneService constructs a frozen `ValidatedRemediationCandidate` via the Body-owned trusted validation service (ADR-154 D2), which re-reads the persisted verdict of the named validation run from `core.fix_runs` (it never trusts the caller's claim that validation passed) and confirms the submitted patch matches the bytes that were validated. The existing `proposals approve`/`execute` path drives the rest.

get.description: Return all secret keys with timestamps. Values are never returned.

schema.title: Response List Secrets V1 Secrets Get

post.description:
Create or overwrite an encrypted secret.

Returns 409 if the key already exists and `force` is false.

schema.title: Response Set Secret V1 Secrets Post

Return all public, non-test symbols that have capability == 'unassigned'.

Mirrors the filter used by the CORE CLI's `symbols audit` check.

schema.title: Response List Unassigned Symbols V1 Symbols Unassigned Get

get.description:
Return symbol drift counters sourced from the governed pipeline.

Reports anchor_violations (open purity.stable_id_anchor findings),
pending_symbols (core.symbols rows pending classification), and
last_sync_at (most recent DbSyncWorker heartbeat timestamp).

Does not re-scan source — consumes governed pipeline output per ADR-143 D3.

schema.title: Response Symbols Drift V1 Symbols Drift Get

get.description: Return all active Qdrant collections with a liveness status.

schema.title: Response Vector Status V1 Vectors Status Get

post.summary: Semantic search over a vector collection
post.description:
Embed the query and return the closest matches from the named collection.

`collection` may be a short alias ('policies', 'patterns', 'specs', 'code')
or the raw Qdrant collection name.
Returns up to `limit` results ordered by descending similarity.

schema.title: Response Vector Query V1 Vectors Query Post

post.summary: Delete a Qdrant collection and reset chunk_count
post.description:
Delete a Qdrant collection and reset chunk_count so RepoEmbedderWorker repopulates.

Dry-run by default — returns how many artifacts would be re-embedded.
Pass write=true to apply (destructive: deletes the live collection).

RepoEmbedderWorker recreates the collection with current vectors on its next cycle.

schema.title: Response Vector Rebuild V1 Vectors Rebuild Post

post.description:
Generate the canonical Capability Reference from the knowledge graph.

Fetches public capabilities from core.knowledge_graph and writes
docs/10_CAPABILITY_REFERENCE.md via FileHandler. The `output` parameter
is accepted for forward compatibility; the current implementation writes
to the fixed path docs/10_CAPABILITY_REFERENCE.md.

schema.title: Response Generate Docs V1 Project Docs Post

post.summary: Deliver BYOR machinery floor to an external repo
post.description:
Deliver the CORE machinery floor into an external repository (BYOR Phase A).

Copies META schemas, taxonomies, constitution stub, and enforcement/config
from examples/starter-intent/.intent/ into <path>/.intent/. Dry-run by default.
Pass write=true to apply; pass stage=true with write=true to stage for inspection.

Requires the caller and the CORE API to be co-located on the same host/
filesystem: `path` is resolved and written on the API host, not the
caller's machine. This is not a convenience assumption but a consequence
of ADR-054 D3 (core-api is loopback-bound, single-operator, no auth) —
a remote consumer CLI (ADR-146 D2) cannot safely direct writes to an
arbitrary server-side path without authentication, which loopback-only
Phase 1 does not provide. See F-1, `.specs/planning/archive/CORE-CLI-2.9.0-Followups.md`.

schema.title: Response Onboard Project V1 Project Onboard Post

post.summary: Promote a staged machinery floor to target
post.description:
Promote a staged machinery floor into the target repository (ADR-123 D2).

Reads from work/staged/<name>/.intent/ and writes to <path>/.intent/.
Run POST /project/onboard with write=true and stage=true first.

Requires the caller and the CORE API to be co-located on the same host/
filesystem — same constraint as POST /project/onboard; see that docstring
and F-1 in `.specs/planning/archive/CORE-CLI-2.9.0-Followups.md`.

schema.title: Response Promote Onboard V1 Project Onboard Promote Post

post.summary: Detect signals and induce candidate governance rules
post.description:
Detect, suggest, and catalog-match candidate governance rules for a target repo.

Phase B of ADR-119 (rule induction). Returns ScoutObservations and a list of
RuleCandidate dicts for the caller to ratify. Does NOT write .intent/ files —
the caller (CLI) handles interactive ratification and writes using its local
filesystem access.

Steps performed by this route:
1. Extract aggregate AST signals from <path> (ScoutAnalyzer — PARSE phase).
2. Call ScoutInducer (Mind) via injected cognitive_service to get LLM candidates.
   Falls back to the embedded 4-rule universal menu if LLM is unavailable.
3. Match each candidate against the enforcement catalog (engine + params + scope).

Returns {"path": ..., "signals": {...}, "candidates": [...]} where each candidate
includes rule_id, statement, enforcement, rationale, and optional engine/params/scope
fields when a catalog match exists.

Requires Phase A (project onboard) to have delivered .intent/ to the target.

schema.title: Response Scout Project V1 Project Scout Post

post.description: Start a constitutional audit run against the repo. With `wait=false` (default) returns 202 + a `run_id` to poll; the audit executes on a background task. With `wait=true` blocks and returns the full result (verdict + findings + stats) in-band (status 200). Audit duration is ~60s; clients invoking `wait=true` must set a long HTTP timeout.

schema.title: Response Create Audit Run V1 Audit Runs Post

schema.title: Response List Audit Runs V1 Audit Runs Get

get.description: Read back an audit run's persisted record by `run_id`: verdict + counts + timestamps + status + findings list. Returns 404 if the run doesn't exist. Findings are denormalized on `core.audit_runs.findings` per ADR-054 amendment; pre-amendment rows return an empty list.

post.description: Trigger autonomous remediation of findings from a prior audit run (`audit_run_id`). `mode` selects aggressiveness — wire vocabulary is `safe` | `medium` | `all`. `write=false` is the dry-run default (ADR-014). Returns 202 + a `run_id` for the new remediation run; use `GET /v1/audit/remediations/{run_id}` to read the result. 422 if `mode` is outside the allowed vocabulary.

get.description: Read back a remediation run's persisted record by `run_id`: mode, write flag, status, timestamps, result, and error if any. Returns 404 if the run doesn't exist.

post.description:
Run the integration workflow (stage → format/lint → commit).

Returns 200 on success. Translates a failed workflow into a 502
so the CLI can render a clear error; the underlying exit_code is
surfaced in the detail object.

Run black --check and ruff check on src/ and tests/.

Returns 200 with the structured result regardless of pass/fail —
the response's `ok` field carries the verdict, and `tools.*` carry
per-tool returncodes and captured output. This avoids the
"lint findings = HTTP error" anti-pattern; a clean lint and a
dirty lint are both successful API calls.

Run an atomic action from the registry by `fix_id` (e.g. `fix.format`, `fix.imports`, `fix.docstrings`). Returns 422 if `fix_id` is unknown — the response body includes a registered ids count. Valid ids return 202 + a `run_id` to poll. `write=false` is the dry-run default (ADR-014). `params` carries action-specific kwargs (e.g. `fix.docstrings`'s `limit`) and is forwarded as `**kwargs` to ActionExecutor.execute.
Run the `flow.fix_code` curated sequence — a registered Flow YAML that bundles the standard fix-category atomic actions in their ADR-sanctioned execution order. Returns 202 + a `run_id`.

Run the modularity remediation cycle — a Python-level workflow (ModularityRemediationService), not a Flow YAML — so there's no flow_id to validate. `params` supports `min_score` + `limit` for candidate selection. Returns 202 + a `run_id`.

Bootstrap an Intent Representation (IR) scaffold file of the requested `kind` (`triage` or `log`). Synchronous — returns the relative path that was written. No background task; no core.fix_runs row. Returns 422 if `kind` is outside the closed vocabulary.

get.description: Return metadata for atomic actions whose category is `fix`. Use `GET /v1/actions` for the unfiltered view across every category.

Read back a fix run's persisted record by `run_id`. The response shape matches ADR-055 D2: run_id, status, fix_id, kind, write, result, error. `result` is the JSONB ActionResult payload written by the background task; null while the run is still pending or executing. Returns 404 if no run exists with that id.

Return metadata for every registered atomic action. Used by OEM integrators to discover what governance primitives are available for embedding. For the fix-category-only view, use `GET /v1/fix/commands`.

schema.title: Response List Actions V1 Actions Get

post.description:
Run the import-resolution check inline over the governed repository's
src/ (its root when it has no src/). Returns {status, violations}.
Dispatch pytest, optionally scoped to a path. Async.

get.description: Run the constitutional coverage compliance check — pass/fail verdict against the configured coverage targets. F-45 (hosted findings) renders this alongside audit findings for the same PR snapshot.

schema.title: Response Coverage Check V1 Coverage Check Get

get.description: Return the most recently completed pytest coverage report from `core.coverage_runs`. `format=text` (default) returns the latest text-format run; `format=html` returns the latest html-format run. 404 with a hint to POST /v1/coverage/reports if no completed report-run of the requested format exists yet. GET no longer runs pytest inline (closes #608) — POST /v1/coverage/reports kicks off a fresh run as a background task.

schema.title: Response Coverage Report V1 Coverage Report Get

get.description: Return the constitutional coverage targets — module-level thresholds the audit gate enforces. Sidecar configuration surface.

schema.title: Response Coverage Targets V1 Coverage Targets Get

get.description: Return modules ranked by coverage deficit below `threshold` (default 75.0, range 0-100). `limit` caps results (default 20, max 200). F-34 dashboards use this as an actionable surface for operators to triage test debt.

schema.title: Response Coverage Gaps V1 Coverage Gaps Get

get.description: Return recent coverage measurements (newest first). `limit` defaults to 30, max 500. F-20-adjacent — surfaces coverage trajectory alongside the convergence metric.

schema.title: Response Coverage History V1 Coverage History Get

get.description: Read back a coverage run's persisted record by `run_id`: status, timestamps, result payload, error. Returns 404 if no run exists with that id.

schema.title: Response Get Coverage Run V1 Coverage Runs  Run Id  Get

get.description: Return the constitutional modularity score threshold — files scoring above this are refactor candidates. Sidecar configuration surface.

schema.title: Response Refactor Threshold V1 Refactor Threshold Get

get.description: Return the per-file modularity score for `file` (relative path). Returns 404 if the file is unknown / missing; analyzable files return the full details payload from the modularity engine.

schema.title: Response Refactor Score V1 Refactor Score Get

get.description: Return files exceeding the modularity threshold, highest score first. `min_score` filters to files at or above the given score (0-200); `limit` caps results (default 50, max 500). F-34 dashboards use this as an actionable refactor backlog view.

schema.title: Response Refactor Candidates V1 Refactor Candidates Get

get.description: Return the aggregate modularity-score distribution across the codebase — histogram + percentile summary used for trend analysis and dashboard rendering.

schema.title: Response Refactor Stats V1 Refactor Stats Get

get.description: Read back a refactor run's persisted record by `run_id`: status, timestamps, captured proposal_ids in `result`, error. Returns 404 if no run exists with that id.

schema.title: Response Get Refactor Run V1 Refactor Runs  Run Id  Get

get.description: Read-only DB-state snapshot: connection liveness + schema introspection summary. F-34 (web dashboard) uses this for the worker-health surface.

schema.title: Response Status Db V1 Status Db Get

get.description: Return a consolidated drift snapshot for symbols and/or vectors. `scope=symbols` and `scope=vectors` filter to one axis; `scope=all` (default) returns both. F-20 (convergence dashboard) consumes this to render real-time drift state alongside the convergence trajectory.

schema.title: Response Status Drift V1 Status Drift Get

get.description: Return recent constitutional decision traces with optional filters: `session_id` scopes to one session; `agent` filters to a specific actor; `pattern` filters to a named decision pattern. `limit` defaults to 50 (max 500). Empty filters return the global newest-first stream.

schema.title: Response Analysis Bridges V1 Analysis Bridges Get

get.description: Deprecated (ADR-087 D4): never had a backend and always returns `available: false` with an empty `clusters` list. Sunset 2027-04-04; removed at /v2/. `limit` is accepted (max 200, default 25) and ignored.

schema.title: Response Analysis Clusters V1 Analysis Clusters Get

schema.title: Response Analysis Duplicates V1 Analysis Duplicates Get

schema.title: Response Analysis Common Knowledge V1 Analysis Common Knowledge Get

schema.title: Response Analysis Command Tree V1 Analysis Command Tree Get

schema.title: Response Analysis Test Targets V1 Analysis Test Targets Get

get.description: Return the registered V2 component inventory across the Mind/Body/Will layers. Optional `type` query filters to one component class (e.g. `analyzer`, `evaluator`, `strategist`). F-34 dashboards use this to render the component health surface.

schema.title: Response Components List V1 Components Get

get.description: Semantic search across the capability registry via the Will cognitive service. `q` is the query (min length 1, required). `limit` caps results (default 10, max 200). Returns capabilities ranked by semantic similarity to the query.

schema.title: Response Search Capabilities V1 Search Capabilities Get

get.description: Fuzzy substring search over the CLI command registry (ADR-057 D5). `q` is the search string (min length 1, required). `limit` caps results (default 25, max 200).

schema.title: Response Search Commands V1 Search Commands Get

post.description: Trigger a CIM-0 structural census snapshot of the constitution and codebase. Returns 202 + a `run_id` to poll. F-20 (Convergence dashboard) ingests these snapshots over time to render the finding-rate vs resolution-rate trajectory.

get.description: Read back a census run's persisted record by `run_id`: snapshot, baseline_name, status, timestamps, result, error. Returns 404 if the run doesn't exist.

post.description: Promote a census snapshot to a named baseline. F-20 dashboards use baselines as reference points for the convergence trajectory. `snapshot_file` is optional; when omitted, the most recent snapshot is used. Returns 422 if no usable snapshot exists.

get.description: Return all named baselines (newest first).

get.summary: Compare current state to a baseline
get.description: Diff the current census state against a baseline. The optional `baseline` query param selects which named baseline to compare against; omit to use the default baseline if configured. Returns the structured delta consumed by F-20 dashboards.

post.description: Create a SHA256 baseline of src/ and return path + file count.
Verify src/ against the named baseline and return ok / errors.

get.description: Returns 200 OK whenever the API process is responsive. Public; unauthenticated; safe to poll at high frequency.

ActionCommandItem.title: ActionCommandItem
ActionCommandItem.description: Metadata for one registered atomic action (GET /v1/fix/commands).

ApproveRequest.title: ApproveRequest
ApproveRequest.description:
Body for POST /proposals/{id}/approve.

`approved_by` is derived server-side from the request context and is
not accepted from the request body.

AsyncDispatchResponse.title: AsyncDispatchResponse
AsyncDispatchResponse.description:
Standard 202 response for all async-dispatch POST endpoints.

Callers poll `href` to read the persisted run record once the
background task completes.

CensusBaselineItem.title: CensusBaselineItem
CensusBaselineItem.description: A single named census baseline record.

CensusDiffResponse.title: CensusDiffResponse
CensusDiffResponse.description:
GET /v1/census/diff response.

`available=False` when no snapshot or baseline exists; `diff` carries
the CensusDiff model_dump when available.

CensusRunResponse.title: CensusRunResponse
CensusRunResponse.description:
GET /v1/census/runs/{run_id} response.

Intentionally omits `requested_by` (internal username) per #727.

ConsequenceRecord.title: ConsequenceRecord
ConsequenceRecord.description: Execution consequence: what the proposal actually changed.

CreateAuditRunRequest.title: CreateAuditRunRequest
CreateAuditRunRequest.description:
Body for POST /audit/runs.

Empty body is valid and equivalent to a default-constructed model
(full audit, async, no LLM-cache bypass).

CreateBaselineRequest.title: CreateBaselineRequest
CreateBaselineRequest.description:
Body for POST /census/baselines/{name}.

`snapshot_file` is optional — when omitted the most recent snapshot
is used. The handler maps the missing-snapshot case to 422.

CreateProposalRequest.title: CreateProposalRequest
CreateProposalRequest.description:
Body for POST /proposals.

`write=False` is a dry-run: server builds the Proposal and computes
risk but does not persist. `write=True` persists via
ProposalService.create.

CreateRemediationRequest.title: CreateRemediationRequest
CreateRemediationRequest.description:
Body for POST /audit/remediations (ADR-057 D4).

`audit_run_id` is the prior `core.audit_runs` row whose findings are
to be remediated. `mode` is the aggressiveness selector — wire
vocabulary 'safe' | 'medium' | 'all' (mapped onto RemediationMode at
the facade). `write=false` is the dry-run default (ADR-014).

DocsRequest.title: DocsRequest
DocsRequest.description:
Pydantic model declaring the target output path for generated API reference documentation.

Args:
    output: Filesystem or repository-relative path where the documentation
        will be written, defaulting to the capabilities reference file.

FindingEvidence.title: FindingEvidence
FindingEvidence.description: A single blackboard finding linked to a proposal.

FixIRResponse.title: FixIRResponse
FixIRResponse.description: POST /v1/fix/ir synchronous response — the written scaffold path.

GovernanceChainResponse.title: GovernanceChainResponse
GovernanceChainResponse.description:
GET /v1/proposals/{id}/chain and /v1/findings/{id}/chain response.

Traces a finding from detection through approval, execution, and file
changes. consequence is None when the proposal has not yet been executed.

ImportViolation.title: ImportViolation
ImportViolation.description: One unresolved or stale import found by POST /v1/quality/imports.

IntegrateResponse.title: IntegrateResponse
IntegrateResponse.description: POST /v1/integrate success response (a failed workflow returns 502).

IntegrityRequest.title: IntegrityRequest
IntegrityRequest.description:
Body for POST /integrity/baseline and POST /integrity/verify.

Empty body is valid and equivalent to label='default'.

LaneBundle.title: LaneBundle
LaneBundle.description: Context bundle attached to a delegated finding (ADR-109 #653).

LaneBundleRule.title: LaneBundleRule
LaneBundleRule.description: Rule metadata within a lane finding bundle (ADR-109 #653).

LaneFindingItem.title: LaneFindingItem
LaneFindingItem.description: A single delegated finding from the Assisted Remediation Lane.

LaneFindingListResponse.title: LaneFindingListResponse
LaneFindingListResponse.description: GET /v1/lane response — paginated delegated finding list.

LaneFindingWithBundle.title: LaneFindingWithBundle
LaneFindingWithBundle.description: Delegated finding enriched with the ADR-109 #653 context bundle.

LintResponse.title: LintResponse
LintResponse.description:
POST /v1/lint response.

`ok` is the verdict; `tools` is keyed by tool name (`black`, `ruff`) and is
empty when `error` reports a missing tool binary.

LintToolResult.title: LintToolResult
LintToolResult.description: One tool's outcome inside a POST /v1/lint response.

OnboardRequest.title: OnboardRequest
OnboardRequest.description:
Represents a request to onboard a new file into the repository.

Both the file path and the execution mode are declared explicitly so the
caller can decide whether to persist changes or stage them for review.

Args:
    path: Filesystem path to the file being onboarded.
    write: When True, applies changes directly to the filesystem.
           When False, performs a dry-run reporting what would change.
    stage: When True, prepares the changes as a staged commit for review.

PromoteRequest.title: PromoteRequest
PromoteRequest.description:
Request to promote a file or resource from one state to a higher-priority tier.

Represents the minimal payload needed to trigger a governance-aware promotion action,
where the target is identified solely by its filesystem path.

Args:
    path: Filesystem path identifying the resource to be promoted.

ProposalActionItem.title: ProposalActionItem
ProposalActionItem.description: Single action entry in a ProposalResponse.

ProposalSummary.title: ProposalSummary
ProposalSummary.description: Proposal fields relevant to the governance chain.

ProposeRequest.title: ProposeRequest
ProposeRequest.description:
Body for `POST /lane/{finding_id}/propose`.

The agent-authored unified diff plus the id of the `assisted.validate_diff`
run that already cleared it (an `assisted.validate_diff` action dispatched
via `POST /fix/run/{fix_id}`, tracked in `core.fix_runs`). LaneService
(via the Body-owned trusted validation service) re-reads that run's
persisted verdict — it never trusts the caller's word that validation
passed.

RunFixRequest.title: RunFixRequest
RunFixRequest.description:
Body for POST /fix/run/{fix_id}.

Empty body is valid and equivalent to a default-constructed model
(no target file restriction, dry-run).

`params` carries action-specific kwargs (e.g. fix.docstrings's
`limit`); forwarded as **kwargs to ActionExecutor.execute.

RunFlowRequest.title: RunFlowRequest
RunFlowRequest.description:
Body for POST /fix/all and POST /fix/modularity.

`params` carries operation-specific kwargs (e.g. /fix/modularity's
`min_score` and `limit`); forwarded as **kwargs by route handlers
that honor them. /fix/all currently ignores params — caller can
pass them but they are unused.

ScoutRequest.title: ScoutRequest
ScoutRequest.description:
Request model for a scout operation targeting a filesystem path.

Encapsulates the path to explore and whether prior scout state should be
cleared before beginning a fresh walk.

Args:
    path: Filesystem path the scout should examine.
    reset: When True, discards any cached or previous scout results for
           the given path before starting.

SecretRotateRequest.title: SecretRotateRequest
SecretRotateRequest.description:
Data model for a request to rotate a secret's value.

Describes the replacement value to be applied when rotating a governed
secret, enabling substitution of the existing credential with a new one.

Args:
    new_value: The secret string that will replace the current value.

SecretSetRequest.title: SecretSetRequest
SecretSetRequest.description:
Internal contract for storing a secret via the secret-management API.

Encapsulates the full set of parameters required to create or update a
secret, with optional metadata and an override flag for existing entries.

Args:
    key: The unique identifier of the secret to store.
    value: The secret's content to be persisted securely.
    description: Human-readable metadata describing the secret's purpose.
    force: When True, overwrites an existing secret with the same key
        instead of raising a conflict.

VectorQueryRequest.title: VectorQueryRequest
VectorQueryRequest.description:
Request model for vector similarity searches against a knowledge collection.

Encapsulates the search query, target collection, and result limit with
constitutional bounds (1-50) enforced at the schema level.

Args:
    query: The natural-language search text to match against stored vectors.
    collection: Name of the vector collection to query (default: "policies").
    limit: Maximum number of results to return, constrained to 1-50.

VectorRebuildRequest.title: VectorRebuildRequest
VectorRebuildRequest.description:
Request to rebuild vector embeddings for a collection.

Represents an atomic, governed action intent to reindex or reconstruct
vector data within a specified collection, optionally persisting the
result based on write-mode.

Args:
    collection: Name of the target collection to rebuild.
    write: When True, persist the rebuilt vectors; when False,
        perform a dry-run without making changes.
